fields.description: Issue includes editorials and commentary on the prospects and regulation of horse racing in Miami, including concerns about wagering and political corruption; a report on a city ordinance affecting dry cleaners and tailors (including a proposed bond requirement) and calls for its repeal; an editorial about an alligator-killing arrest on the Tamiami Trail and its impact on relations with the Everglades area; coverage of local sports support for the Miami Basketball Club; letters and opinion pieces on public entertainments at Bayfront and on Dade County school administration and teacher pay; and a public-safety editorial urging protection for nurses following reported assaults.
